Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

Olympic Games noun

also Olympics, Olympic, Olympic champion, winter Olympics, summer Olympics

classical

Cic. Div. 2.144: ad Olympia proficīscī
Hor. Ep. 1.1.50
M-O s.v. Olympics, Olympic Games

Olympia, Olympiōrum n. pl.

noun, second declension, plural

The Greek τὰ Ὀλύμπια; a victory there is Olympiōrum victōria (Cic. Tusc. 2.41). Morgan–Owens, after Egger, calls the summer and winter games Olympia aestīva and Olympia hīberna.

Other words

  • Olympionīcēs, Olympionīcae m. — Olympic champion

    noun, first declension · classical · Cic. Fl. 31; M-O s.v. Olympic champion or victor

  • lūdī Olympiī

    also used · classical · Plaut. Stich. 2.1.34 (Lewis & Short s.v. Olympius)

Examples

  • sīc ut fortis equus, spatiō quī saepe suprēmō vīcit Olympia

    like a brave horse that often won at Olympia on the last lapEnn. ap. Cic. Sen. 14 (Lewis & Short)
